root.label: OMB plans $2 billion global health funds for USAID closeout costs

events.label: OMB plans $2 billion global health funds for USAID closeout costs

slots.name: closeout funding plan
slots.sentence: The Office of Management and Budget, headed by Russel T. Vought and charged with shutting down U.S.A.I.D., in April notified Congress of a plan to use $2 billion of global health money for “closeout costs” for grants from the dismantled U.S.A.I.D. — costs such as severance to employees and terminating leases for office space around the world.

slots.name: redirected funds
slots.sentence: Since that notification, about $650 million of those funds have been redirected for the Ebola response and other global health security efforts.

slots.name: remaining closeout funds
slots.sentence: But $1.35 billion, which has to be used by Sept. 30, remains marked by the O.M.B. for closeout costs.
